A. One project, start to finish (recommended)

Cost: about 1 day. Plain page, no scroll behavior, no script. Six photos, one per step except step 1.

Risk: the section grows from one pinned screen to about six screens of scroll. The week label sits above each step name, which is a small label over a heading (the no-eyebrow rule), so it needs your OK.

Made by people we know

Most of what we sell is made in the Philippines, in small workshops that still cut, weave, and throw by hand. We visit them, and we name them.

How Lilim House went, in 18 weeks

  1. Discovery call

    We talk about your space, your brief, and your budget.

    Week 0

    You receive a 30-minute call, at no cost.

  2. Site visit and proposal

    We measure the space and send a fixed design fee and a budget range.

    Week 1

    You receive a fixed design fee and a budget range.

  3. Design

    You see layouts, materials, and a full furnishing plan.

    Weeks 2 to 6

    You receive layouts, a material palette, and the furnishing plan, with two rounds of revisions.

  4. Making and ordering

    We order every piece and work with the makers who build them.

    Weeks 7 to 16

    You receive progress photos from the workshops.

  5. Delivery and installation

    We deliver, assemble, and place everything in six days on site.

    Weeks 17 to 18

    You receive a finished room, installed.

  6. Styling and handover

    We style each room, walk you through it, and leave a care guide.

    Week 18

    You receive a care guide and a visit after 30 days.

Tell us about your space.

A discovery call takes 30 minutes and costs nothing. Furnishing projects start at ₱1,500,000.
